name: List All Tenants
description: Returns all tenants that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[UnitId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unit unique identifier. Multiple values should be separated by commas.

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter tenants updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[Status]
queryFilters.description: Filter the results based on one or more statuses. Multiple values should be separated by commas.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of tenant objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the tenant

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique Identifier of an occupancy of one or more tenants

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: The unit the tenant occupies

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: The property with the unit occupied by the tenant

responseFields.name: data[].FirstName
responseFields.description: The tenant's first name

responseFields.name: data[].MiddleName
responseFields.description: The tenant's middle name

responseFields.name: data[].LastName
responseFields.description: The tenant's last name

responseFields.name: data[].BirthDate
responseFields.description: The tenant's birthdate

responseFields.name: data[].SocialSecurityNumber
responseFields.description: The tenant's social security number

responseFields.name: data[].Link
responseFields.description: A link to the tenant's page in the AppFolio Property manager

responseFields.name: data[].CompanyName
responseFields.description: The display name of the tenant's company

responseFields.name: data[].CurrentRent
responseFields.description: The amount the tenant currently pays for rent

responseFields.name: data[].Status
responseFields.description: The status of the tenant

responseFields.name: data[].Addresses
responseFields.description: The tenant's address(es)

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumber
responseFields.description: The tenant's primary phone number

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumbers
responseFields.description: The tenant's phone number(s)

responseFields.name: data[].Email
responseFields.description: The tenant's primary email address

responseFields.name: data[].Emails
responseFields.description: The tenant's emails

responseFields.name: data[].MoveInOn
responseFields.description: The date the tenant physically started or will start occupancy. Dictates whether the "future" or "current" option is displayed in the status field.

responseFields.name: data[].MoveOutOn
responseFields.description: The date the tenant physically ended or will end occupancy. Dictates whether the "notice" or "past" option is displayed in the status field.

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyCustomFields

responseFields.name: data[].RentalApplicationId

responseFields.name: data[].TenantType

responseFields.name: data[].PrimaryTenant
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the tenant is the primary leaseholder for the occupancy

responseFields.name: data[].LastLeaseRenewal
responseFields.description: The date the last lease renewal agreement was started

responseFields.name: data[].LeaseSignedDate
responseFields.description: The date the lease was executed by the tenant

responseFields.name: data[].LeaseStartDate
responseFields.description: The day the lease agreement starts

responseFields.name: data[].LeaseEndDate
responseFields.description: The last day of the lease agreement

responseFields.name: data[].IsMonthlyLease

responseFields.name: data[].NextRentIncrease

responseFields.name: data[].Pets
responseFields.description: Contains details about the tenant's pet(s)

responseFields.name: data[].Vehicles
responseFields.description: Contains details about the tenant's vehicle(s)

responseFields.name: data[].Tags
responseFields.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the tenant

responseFields.name: data[].HiddenAt
responseFields.description: When the tenant was placed into an inactive state by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the tenant's details were last updated
